text: Application malheureusement payante, ce qui explique probablement que les dernier commentaires datent de 4 ans ! L'intention est bonne et c'est exactement le type d'outil dont j'aurais besoin mais la version gratuite ne permet pas de s'organiser correctement. On est réduit à un choix de matières qui ne correspondent pas à nos études.
author: Mary Lill
developer_reply:
All core features are free to help you stay organized — including classes, tasks, and exams. You can also customize your subjects under Settings to match your specific studies. Thanks for the feedback!

— The MyStudyLife Team

text: Great app!! The only thing that it misses is to have a widget, to be able to see the calendar and so, in the home page of the mobile
author: Judith Hernández Ribé
developer_reply:
Hi Judith! Thank you ever so much for leaving a superb review; we really appreciate you making the effort. We are glad you find our app great! Your widget suggestions are duly noted and we will see if we can incorporate it on our next update. Please spread the love and tell all your friends about MyStudyLife!😊😊
#HappyStudying
